requirement.description: The base NotifyBase.send() method currently returns False, but tests expect NotImplementedError to be raised when the method is called directly (not overridden by subclasses).
requirement.contract: The base send() method should raise NotImplementedError to indicate that subclasses must implement this method, instead of returning False.

requirement.description: Plugin instantiation logic checks for enabled status before instantiation, but there are issues with the disabled plugin logic in the test suite.
requirement.contract: Plugins that are disabled at the class level (enabled = False) should not be instantiated, and plugins that become disabled after initialization should also not be instantiated.

requirement.description: The async_notify method needs to properly handle disabled plugins and ensure that disabled plugins don't get executed.
requirement.contract: Async notifications should respect the enabled flag of plugins and not proceed with notification if the plugin is disabled.

requirement.description: Many plugins lack proper parse_url() implementation, which is required for URL parsing and validation.
requirement.contract: All plugins must implement a parse_url() method that properly parses and validates URLs according to their schema requirements.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_plugin_*.py test cases that validate URL parsing

requirement.description: Many plugins lack proper send() implementation, causing notification calls to fail.
requirement.contract: All plugins must implement a send() method that performs actual notification sending or returns False for failure.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_plugin_*.py test cases that validate notification sending
